# Watcher24

> Real-time observability, audit logging, and telemetry platform for modern applications.

Watcher24 ingests logs, metrics, traces, and audit events from SDKs, processes them through a
pipeline, and displays them on a real-time dashboard. It supports multi-tenant organisations,
API key management, role-based access control, Stripe billing, and a tamper-evident compliance
audit trail.

## Installation

### JavaScript / Node.js (server)
npm install @watcher/node

### JavaScript (browser)
npm install @watcher/browser

### React hooks
npm install @watcher/react

### Next.js (server + client + middleware)
npm install @watcher/nextjs

### Python
pip install watcher-sdk

## Initialisation

### Node.js
```js
import { createNodeClient } from "@watcher/node";
const watcher = createNodeClient({
  apiKey: process.env.W24_API_KEY,
  appId: "my-service",
  environment: "production",          // optional
  gatewayUrl: "https://ingest.watcher24.io", // optional
});
process.on("SIGTERM", () => watcher.shutdown());
```

### Python
```python
from watcher_sdk import Client
import os, atexit
watcher = Client(
    api_key=os.environ["W24_API_KEY"],
    app_id="my-service",
    environment="production",
)
atexit.register(watcher.shutdown)
```

## Core methods (all SDKs)

### audit(message, options)
Records user actions and compliance events. Always include userId.
```js
watcher.audit("user.login", { userId: "usr_123", payload: { ip: "1.2.3.4" } });
watcher.audit("document.deleted", { userId, payload: { docId, reason: "gdpr" } });
```

### log(severity, message, options)
Application log events. severity: "debug" | "info" | "warn" | "error" | "critical"
```js
watcher.log("info", "server.started", { payload: { port: 3000 } });
watcher.log("error", "db.query.failed", { payload: { error: err.message } });
```

### trace(message, options)
Distributed trace spans. Include traceId to correlate spans across services.
```js
watcher.trace("http.request", {
  traceId: req.headers["x-trace-id"] ?? crypto.randomUUID(),
  payload: { method: "POST", path: "/api/orders", status: 201, durationMs: 42 },
});
```

### metric(message, options)
Numeric measurements. Put the value in payload.
```js
watcher.metric("orders.total", { payload: { value: 1042 } });
watcher.metric("response.latency_ms", { payload: { value: 120, p99: 340 } });
```

### flush() / shutdown()
```js
await watcher.flush();    // force-send buffered events now
await watcher.shutdown(); // flush then stop background flusher (call before process exit)
```

## React hooks

Wrap your app with WatcherProvider, then use hooks in any component:
```tsx
import { WatcherProvider, useAudit, useLog, useTrace, useMetric } from "@watcher/react";

// Root
<WatcherProvider client={watcherBrowserClient}><App /></WatcherProvider>

// Components
const audit  = useAudit();   audit("button.clicked", { userId, payload: { label } });
const log    = useLog();     log("error", "fetch.failed", { payload: { url } });
const trace  = useTrace();   trace("ui.navigation", { payload: { from, to } });
const metric = useMetric();  metric("cart.items", { payload: { value: items.length } });
```

## Next.js patterns

### Auto-trace all API routes (middleware.ts)
```ts
import { watcherMiddleware } from "@watcher/nextjs";
export const middleware = watcherMiddleware({ apiKey: process.env.W24_API_KEY, appId: "app" });
export const config = { matcher: "/api/:path*" };
```

### Server Component / Route Handler
```ts
import { createNextServerClient } from "@watcher/nextjs/server";
const watcher = createNextServerClient({ apiKey: process.env.W24_API_KEY, appId: "app" });
watcher.audit("page.view", { userId, payload: { page: "/dashboard" } });
```

### Client Component
```tsx
import { useAudit } from "@watcher/nextjs/client";
const audit = useAudit();
audit("button.clicked", { userId, payload: { label: "upgrade" } });
```

## Python FastAPI auto-tracing

```python
from watcher_sdk.integrations.fastapi import instrument
instrument(app, client)  # traces every request automatically
```

## Environment variables

W24_API_KEY           — API key (server-side, keep secret)
W24_APP_ID            — identifies the application in the dashboard
W24_GATEWAY_URL       — override ingest endpoint (default: http://localhost:8080)
W24_ENVIRONMENT       — "development" | "staging" | "production"

NEXT_PUBLIC_W24_API_KEY        — browser-safe key for React/Next.js client
NEXT_PUBLIC_W24_GATEWAY_URL    — browser-side gateway URL

## Event type guide

Use audit()  for: login, logout, CRUD on sensitive data, permission changes, exports
Use log()    for: server errors, warnings, startup/shutdown, background jobs
Use trace()  for: HTTP requests, database queries, external API calls, queue processing
Use metric() for: counts, latencies, queue depths, business KPIs
